locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: et hoc omnes intelligunt Deum
interpretation: A nominal identification kept separate from the existence conclusion, as issue #144 requires. It reports common usage of the name 'God', not a demonstration of divine attributes; whether the first mover has the attributes of the God of classical theism is argued later (ST I qq.3-26). It is not a premise of the prima via result.
